svg.text: charuco_r6_40cm_acrylic: ChArUco 15 x 10 squares of 15 mm, markers 11.25 mm, DICT_5X5_1000, legacy_pattern=False, board 225 x 150 mm
Print at 100 % (no fit-to-page). Check the scale with a caliper between SAME-SIDE edges (e.g. left edges of the first and last columns: 210 mm),
not the outer extent: printers enlarge black areas. Generated 2026-11-18 by metrogram target-svg.
